title: Comprehensive transcriptome analysis in human liver
why: 17 primary HCC tumors and 22 benign adjacent liver samples. Cell lines are excluded.

title: Integrative analysis of DNA methylation and microRNA expression reveals mechanisms of disparity in hepatocellular carcinoma [RNA-Seq]
why: 16 HCC tumors and 16 adjacent normal samples from a US cohort.

title: RNA-seq analysis of hepatocellular carcinoma
why: 17 paired HCC and non-neoplastic liver samples from Caucasian patients.

title: mRNA profiling  of Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC)
why: 21 HBV-related HCC tumors, each paired with its adjacent normal liver, from transplant patients.

title: RNA-seq of HCC and paired non-neoplastic liver
why: 21 HCC tumors with paired non-neoplastic liver, with mixed HBV/HCV etiology.

title: Transcriptome sequencing identify a recurrent CRYL1-IFT88 chimeric transcript in hepatocellular carcinoma
why: 9 paired HCC and adjacent non-tumorous liver samples spanning three grades of differentiation.

title: Gene expression profile of clinical LUAD tumors and their paired non-cancerous adjacent tissues by RNA-seq analysis
why: Patient tissue with 51 adenocarcinoma tumours and 49 paired adjacent normal lung samples. It is the largest tumour-vs-normal series found.
control_hint: Paired non-cancerous adjacent lung tissue (49 samples)

title: Multi-omics Analysis reveals novel therapeutic vulnerabilities in lung cancer
why: Paired tumour and adjacent normal tissue for both adenocarcinoma and squamous cell carcinoma. The two subtypes can be pooled or analysed separately.
case_hint: Tumour tissue, adenocarcinoma and squamous combined (32 samples)

title: Research on Differences and Immune Infiltration-Related Macrophages Between Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer and Adjacent Tissues
why: Early-stage non-small cell lung cancer tumour tissue vs adjacent non-cancerous tissue from the same patients, with none of the samples treated.

title: Non-small cell lung cancer tumors and normal lung tissue RNA-seq (Uppsala cohort)
why: A large human bulk RNA-seq cohort that includes NSCLC tumors (adenocarcinoma and squamous) and non-malignant lung tissue in the same series. It suits tumor vs. normal or adenocarcinoma vs. squamous comparisons.
case_hint: NSCLC tumor samples (or one histology only)
